text:
ITEM 1 | Dark leafy greens (spinach-like), flat bright green leaves with visible stems, spread across the bottom and sides of the bowl, forming a thin layer with some leaves folded | 35
ITEM 2 | Sliced avocado, pale green flesh with slightly darker green edges, soft-looking wedges about 1-2 cm thick, glossy and moist surface, scattered in clusters over the greens | 80
ITEM 3 | Cubed white meat pieces, off-white to pale tan, opaque, firm-looking cubes about 1.5-2 cm across, some with light browning on edges, dry surface, scattered throughout the bowl | 90
ITEM 4 | Shaved or shredded pale yellow-white cheese, thin irregular flakes and slivers about 2-4 cm long, dry matte surface, clumped in places over the salad | 40
ITEM 5 | Dark red kidney beans or similar dark red legumes, smooth glossy skins, whole kidney-shaped pieces about 1 cm, sitting among the greens and under other ingredients | 30
ITEM 6 | Shredded orange carrot, thin matchstick strands about 3-5 cm long, bright orange with slightly moist surface, scattered across the top | 15
